note:
Park Drive on the 1901 census - three households, seventeen people - read from the enumerator's page and checked by A. Hagues.

**All three are unfiled.** The record keeps nine properties on Park Drive, numbered 1 to 9 with Ashley House and Clumber House among them. Schedule 222 is headed **"Park Mount"**, a name the record does not hold; the other two carry no name or number at all.

**Park Mount is already under question**, and A. Hagues has said it may be resolvable on foot. Its household is **Otto Homberger**, a lace merchant of 49, a German subject naturalised British, with his wife Kate and three servants - the Kate Homberger whose marriage bears on the Dowson household at Felixstowe.

Henry James Mellors, a lace manufacturer of 49 from Lenton, keeps the largest of the three with eight people.
source: 1901 census enumerator's page for Park Drive, Nottingham, transcribed by A. Hagues.
